unresolved.decision: No physical fasteners or explicit retainers are defined to keep the moving bodies in place along their non-DOF directions.
unresolved.why_open: The bodies are only constrained by joint definitions and contact interfaces, but no explicit fixity to ground is modeled for the housing (BOD-0001) and no fasteners are specified for the revolute and prismatic joints.
